methodology.host: published Cline SDK registry, Agent tool policy and before/after hooks; fixture calls the TypeScript-private executeToolCalls method exposed in published JavaScript
methodology.product_boundary: production uses the public createBuiltinTools executor hook under the normal Agent lifecycle; this fixture enters deterministic tool dispatch directly
methodology.native_seam: apply_patch executor; read_files remains the official builtin filesystem reader
methodology.matching: official computePatchChanges; known-input fixture differences become native line patches with three context lines
methodology.large_file_representation: three explicitly named EOF-hint fixtures retain the original repeated-line bytes and goal; unhinted repeated 64 KiB remains a separate context-scan pressure case
methodology.batching: all files and chunks in one apply_patch call; preparatory reads are grouped in one read_files call
methodology.timed_region: sum of performance.now tool execution durations; fixture creation, patch generation, verification and byte counting are outside
methodology.setup: factory, SDK verification and Agent initialization per lane; first lane includes cold SDK import; native process starts lazily at the first warm-up patch that reaches persistence
methodology.process_lifetime: official SDK wrapper timeout timers keep Node alive after returned tool results; this idle process lifetime is outside warm tool execution timing
methodology.bytes: UTF-8 JSON.stringify public arguments and complete returned SDK tool-result part, including its call ID; output_bytes separately counts the actual output object
methodology.error_outcomes: SDK dispatch isError and operation output.success are recorded separately; official wrappers may return success:false with dispatch isError absent
methodology.p95: nearest rank; three samples give the maximum
methodology.ordering: original then native; fixture order; per-fixture warm-up
methodology.scope: SDK tool executor cohort with model stream counter; model generation, IDE UI and billing are outside this measurement
